source: Clemence refused to take sides.
I saw what happened. Come on, kid. Let's get going.
I hate him.
Thank you, Clemence.
[Get in the car]
That's it? That's all you're going to say?
Give me a moment before we go.
He's, uh, managing some new people, for a new venture. Don't bother him right now, okay? He's...emotional.
What am I supposed to do, then?
Right... Give me a second, alright? [Leave]
Fuck that. He abandoned me in there.
Now? Reception, I suppose. Food, and a glass of wine. You're old enough to drink, aren't you? Come on, I'll drive you there.
Yeah. Let's go now.
I don't really have an appetite right now.
Can I drive?
Not ready for that yet. I'll be right back.
I know you don't. But, the two of you are very...similar. Headstrong, emotional. Nothing good will come of it right now.
...Fine. Whatever.
I don't care. [Leave]
Alright. Get in. I'll roll down the windows for you.
I don't care. Just go.
All the way down? You spoil me.
Thank you, Clemence.
[Say nothing and get in]
Thanks, Uncle.
Thank you. I know it's hard right now, but there's a right time for everything.
So what is it time for now?
Do I have time to call you out on your platitudes?
Sure. Excuse me for a bit, will you? [Leave]
I know it's hard, Clarissa, but don't rush. Take your time with it. I'm here anytime you need me, alright?
[Say nothing]
And also when I don't, I'm sure. What now?
It's going to be okay. Eventually. Hurt goes away, wounds heal. Now come on, how about we head to the reception and get some food in you? I'll drive.
Yeah. Let's go now.
I don't really have an appetite right now.
Can I drive?
Firstly, you should always have an appetite. If there is food, you eat. That's just common sense.
(AMBITIOUS) I like the way you think, Uncle.
And second?
How very like you to say that, Uncle.
I-I understand, Clarissa. It...it's been a long day.
...Are you fucking serious?
That doesn't make it better.
Drive? My car? Hah! Ask me again in ten years, and we'll see where we land on a scale from no to never.
Ten years? We'll see about that.
(CUNNING) It'd make me feel better, uncle...
Pssh. I'd be driving that thing in a week if I asked nice enough.
A meal like this isn't just about food. It's about family. Surrounding yourself with loved ones. Reminding yourself that you're not alone.
Yeah. I understand.
[Glance at your father] Sure felt like it, back there.
Hah! Now, to my other point: dinner is as much about food as it is about family. I know you may not be in the most talkative mood, but having family around is good for the soul. Soothes the mourning.
I get it, I get it. Fair enough.
[Glance at your father] And yet some of us seem to be mourning less than others.
Leave it, bella. Now come on, let's head to that reception.
Alright, sure.
Hold on, give me a minute.
Alright, but don't do anything stupid. I'll be waiting for you here.
I know, Uncle.
[Say nothing]
Good. Now, shall we? I heard they were making roasted eggplant.
Sure. Sounds good.
Just a minute, I'll be right with you.
Good food brings good things, kid. Bad food brings nothing but bad business. And usually vice versa.
Right. And what else?
Words of wisdom.
Now, to my other point: dinner is as much about the food as it is about family. I know you may not be in the most talkative mood, but having family around is good for the soul. Soothes the mourning.
I get it, I get it. Fair enough.
[Glance at your father] And yet some of us seem to be mourning less than others.
If you're looking to take a bet, you better find one with better odds, kid. But who knows - maybe generosity will strike some day.
All the way from the driveway to the road, I'm sure.
I'll believe it when I see it.
Like I said, generosity. Now come on - we've got a reception to go to.
Alright, let's go.
Give me a moment. I'm not done here yet.
It's the least I can do. Lots of emotions today.
...Are you fucking serious?
That doesn't make it better.
Would it? Oh no, I see what you're doing. You knock that off, Clarissa. You try to play tricks like that on your uncle, and you'll see what happens.
Mm-hm.
[Shrug] Wow, you caught me this time. One out of three isn't bad, I guess.
What do you mean...hey! I see what you're doing, kid. Very funny. Come on - let's head to the reception.
Alright, let's go.
Give me a moment. I'm not done here yet.
Now come on! Let's get us both to the reception. People are waiting for us, I'm sure.
Alright, let's go.
Give me a moment, I'm not done here yet.
Then you best get to asking nicely, don't you? For now, why don't we head to the reception?
Alright, let's go.
Give me a moment - I'm not done here yet.
Strangers to you, certainly. They knew your grandfather, though. I know they're not family, but they have a right to be here. Some of them, at least.
Doesn't mean I have to like it.
I saw that. Very clever.
[Shrug] It was simple enough.
You saw it?
Getting your way is one thing, Clarissa. Making enemies is another.
I'd rather have enemies than these vultures for friends.
Just needed it out of my system.
Better to have any friend than an enemy, Clarissa. Someday, you'll see that.
I'm not in the mood for wisdom right now.
Speaking of enemies - what exactly is my father up to, uncle?
In the meantime, I see you've got a new car.
Sure. Could use some work, though.
Tell me - what exactly is my father doing out here?
Did you get a new car, uncle?
I know, Clarissa. I know. I'll talk to him.
[Sigh]
Sure. Give me a second, will you? [Leave]
I can talk to him myself. I don't need your help.
You're not the only quick-fingered fast thinker in the family, Clarissa. Or, I should say, you weren't the first.
What exactly is my father doing?
Is this your car, uncle?
It certainly does not.
...Thank you for understanding that.
...What exactly is my father up to, Uncle?
...When did you get this car, Uncle?
I know, I know... But when it comes to cars, I'm as giddy as one.
Then sure, roll down the windows.
I'm sure. What's my father doing?
I-I just...no, no you're right. It's just...better if I say nothing. Come on. Let's go.
[Get in]
Let's.
[Get in]
I don't think there's much I can say about it, Clarissa. I'm sorry.
...Sorry? My father hits me, and all you can do is say sorry?
Let's just go.
[Get in the car]
I know. Be patient.
Patient? PATIENT?
Let's just go.
So. Are you ready to go?
Not yet. Give me a moment.
Yeah. Let's go.
Heya, kid. You rushed right past me in there, and now I find you standing by the car. Eager to get out of here, huh?
(AMBITIOUS) Eager for it to be over. I didn't want to be there, and I didn't want those strangers to be either.
(CUNNING) It's fine. Just had to cause a little bit of a misunderstanding in there.
(POWERFUL) I couldn't stand the crowds.
Looks like my father was, too.
She's a beauty, isn't she? Want me to roll down the windows for you?
Maybe later.
Uncle, what's my father up to?
I'm not a child, Uncle.
Whatever you want, bella. It's been a long day.
Yeah, I just want it to be over.
What now?
Give me a minute. There's something I need to do.
